name: University of Liège
summary: French-speaking public university in Liège; its bachelor's, from engineering and law to veterinary medicine, are taught in French.

ib.text: A full IB Diploma from an IB-recognised school needs no equivalence. Bachelor's are in French: non-EU applicants must show B2 (DELF, DALF, TEF or TCF); the EU page states no level.

notes: ULiège's 'foreign-language' bachelor's in engineering, computer science and law are marked 'taught in French only'; economics can be taken bilingually in French and German.
EU applicants fill in the online form from mid-February and upload documents before 31 August; the page names no year.
Medicine and dentistry need the ARES entrance exam, and veterinary medicine caps places for non-residents of Belgium.
